content: It includes metrics such as cases averted, disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) averted, incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs), and total costs across various regions and scenarios (low, mid, and high cost). 1. Oceania Region: Under the Infant Vaccination + Birth Dose (BD) 90% by 2020 scenario, guided by high viral load (VL) testing in 2021, 26,404 cases were averted, representing a 19% reduction. This intervention also averted 18,811 DALYs. When guided by HBeAg testing in 2021, 42,829 cases were averted (32% reduction), and 29,796 DALYs were averted. The mid-cost scenario for this intervention incurred a total cost of $39,362,349, while the low-cost scenario saved $45,390,893. The high-cost scenario resulted in an expenditure of $120,556,750. The ICER per case averted, compared to the standard of care (SQ), was $223 in the mid-cost scenario, while the ICER per DALY averted was $159. 2. Asia Pacific High-Income Region: The Infant Vaccination + BD 90% by 2020 scenario, guided by high VL testing, averted 176,835 cases (21% reduction) and 86,905 DALYs. HBeAg-guided testing averted 222,606 cases (27% reduction) and 107,410 DALYs. The mid-cost scenario incurred a total cost of $131,039,923, while the low-cost scenario saved $150,280,419. The high-cost scenario resulted in an expenditure of $391,004,857. The ICER per case averted in the mid-cost scenario was $397, and the ICER per DALY averted was $195. 3.
